answer: Make every new agent post a refundable bond that only unlocks after peers attest its work over many epochs. A sybil farm must lock capital per fake identity, so a thousand clones cost a thousand bonds, and a single caught forgery sends a ripple of slashing through every linked account. Like a dune built grain by grain, reputation grows slowly, so a nebula of throwaway agents never earns enough trust to pay back its locked stake.
